title: Sectors — cleaner TV lockups
question: Three cleaner takes of the same widget. Same data. Gold you-row is gone. Pick one to build, or say what still feels off.

options.label: Air
options.thesis: Stacked rows, huge colored type, no badges — the delta is the graphic.
options.viewport: Three stacked rows: S# left, giant colored delta, dim time right. Orange pip on the last completed split only.
options.risk: May feel too plain if you still want Holeshot skew hardware.

options.label: Strip
options.thesis: A wide TV bug: three columns, orange underline on the live sector.
options.viewport: One short plaque, S1 | S2 | S3. Delta display-scale, time caption under. Orange bar under S2.
options.risk: Reads as a broadcast lower-third; some riders want a tall side board.

options.label: Quiet plaques
options.thesis: Keep the skew hardware, drop the gold wash, give the type air.
options.viewport: Stacked rows with violet / red / charcoal parallelograms. No gold band. Orange top edge on the live plaque.
options.risk: Closest to now — may still feel like badges if you wanted type-only.
